messages.message: Hey, I’ll bring the camera—this is gonna be legendary. And someone needs to confirm if we’re still doing the midnight show or not.
Wait, are we all meeting at the theater or Riley’s place first? Also, does anyone have a spare mask for the Hulk scene?
No way, the Hulk’s roar is nothing. But if it gets too intense, I’ll bring my pillow from the couch. Just don’t make me wear the Iron Man hoodie again—I already have a bruise from last time.
I’ll text the group chat again to confirm times. And Sam, if those cupcakes are as insane as you said, I’m bringing a second bag.

conversation_focus: coordinating movie night details and confirming group plans
